## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Matera, Italy. It starts at Recinto Cavone, 9.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> If you're planning to visit the unique and fascinating Sassi di Matera, this 25-minute multimedia exhibit gives you a great introduction. Explore three rooms of a 16th-century family home, see how the Sassi's early inhabitants lived, and uncover Matera's fascinating history.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €10.69. It was rated 4.9 out of 5 from 33 ratings and 23 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
